At Maersk Container Industry (MCI), we are looking for a skilled and passionate Refrigeration Specialist to join our innovative engineering team.

In this role, you will combine deep technical expertise with creative problem-solving to design and optimize reliable, cost-effective refrigeration solutions. Your work will contribute directly to the development of industry-leading reefer technology that supports global trade.

If you are a technically strong problem-solver who thrives in a collaborative and innovative environment, we would love to hear from you.

What we offer

MCI is headquartered in Tinglev in Southern Denmark, conveniently located near Sønderborg, Kolding, and Flensburg. While we have strong local roots, we operate on a truly global stage.

At MCI, you will experience:

• 
An informal and supportive work environment

• 
A workplace focused on innovation, sustainability, and quality

• 
The opportunity to work with some of the most energy-efficient reefer technologies in the industry

• 
A high degree of independence and flexibility in your daily work

• 
Collaboration with international colleagues from diverse backgrounds

• 
A competitive employee benefits package

We also believe that a great workplace includes enjoying what we do and having fun working together.

Your responsibilities

As our Refrigeration Specialist, you will play a key role in the design, development, and testing of advanced refrigeration systems.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• 
Leading engineering projects (approximately 90% technical work and 10% project management)

• 
Calculating and dimensioning refrigeration components and systems to ensure optimal performance

• 
Contributing to and strengthening the team’s expertise in refrigeration technologies

• 
Managing projects according to the Industrial Stage-Gate Model and presenting progress to steering committees

• 
Setting up laboratory tests, analyzing results, and ensuring system reliability and performance

What we are looking for

To succeed in this role, you combine strong technical capabilities with practical experience and a proactive mindset.

Professional qualifications

• 
A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronic Engineering, or a related technical field

• 
5+ years of relevant engineering experience

• 
A proven track record of delivering technical projects

• 
Solid understanding of thermo-physics, preferably with experience in refrigeration systems

• 
Experience with component development, including DFMEA, test planning, and validation

• 
Experience with stakeholder management

• 
Familiarity with system control (Python programming is considered an advantage)

• 
Experience working with Stage-Gate project models

Personal qualities

We are looking for someone who:

• 
Takes a structured and analytical approach to problem-solving

• 
Works well both independently and as part of a team

• 
Thrives in a fast-paced and informal environment

• 
Has a solution-oriented and results-driven mindset

• 
Can balance being a technical specialist and pragmatic project leader

Location

This position is based at MCI’s headquarters in Tinglev, Denmark.

Interested?

If you have any questions about the position, please contact our HR department at: 📧 hr@mcicontainers.com

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Maersk Container Industry is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace, valuing different perspectives. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants of all backgrounds. We consider qualified candidates with criminal histories in accordance with legal requirements. We are committed to accommodating your needs during the application and hiring process. If you require special assistance or accommodations to use our website, apply for a position, or perform a job, please contact us.

Visit our website to learn more: www.mcicontainers.com

As a Senior Front-End Engineer, you will co-own the front-end experience for Performativ's trading and analytics platform, building high-performance interfaces used by wealth managers and financial institutions. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct ownership of architecture, implementation, and production outcomes.

**About The Team 👥

**The engineering team owns the platform that powers portfolio management, trading, analytics, reporting, compliance, and client engagement at Performativ. Front-end engineers work closely with backend engineers, product, and design to turn complex financial workflows into software that advisors can use every day.

The team ships continuously and gives engineers ownership over implementation decisions. On the front end, the current focus is scaling a Next.js and React architecture across increasingly sophisticated workflows while keeping performance, server and client boundaries, theming, and shared components under control.

**About The Role 🎯

**We are looking for a Senior Front-End Engineer to co-own the quality, performance, and architecture of our trading and analytics interfaces. This role is responsible for building production UIs, shaping front-end architecture, and raising the standard of our shared component infrastructure.

You will work closely with backend engineering, product, and design to ship financial workflows from requirements through production. You will co-own the end-to-end front-end scope, including server and client boundaries, hydration strategy, state management, performance, multi-tenant theming, testing, and the component library used across the platform.

This role requires deep React and TypeScript expertise, strong architectural judgment, and the ability to turn complex financial workflows into fast, usable interfaces. You need to be comfortable making implementation decisions independently and shipping production software without management overhead.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together from our city-center office, with working from home possible when there is a good reason. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

What you'll do 📈

• Build high-performance trading, analytics, and portfolio management interfaces used by wealth management professionals.

• Co-own front-end architecture across Next.js 15, React Server Components, TypeScript, and our shared application infrastructure.

• Define server and client boundaries, hydration strategies, and state patterns that keep the platform responsive as complexity grows.

• Scale our shared component library and multi-tenant theming across the platform.

• Improve runtime performance, bundle size, rendering behavior, and application responsiveness.

• Ship production features quickly while making architectural decisions that hold up as the product scales.

• Use AI coding agents where they improve engineering throughput while maintaining control over code quality and implementation decisions.

• Strengthen front-end testing and delivery across Vitest or Jest, Testing Library, Playwright, and CI/CD workflows.

• Co-own implementation decisions from product outcome through production deployment.

What we're looking for 🔍

• Have built sophisticated production web applications with React and TypeScript and can structure front-end codebases that continue to work as product complexity grows.

• Understand modern React architecture, including React Server Components and the Next.js App Router, or can demonstrate the technical depth to become productive with them quickly.

• Have shipped production work using AI coding agents and understand where they improve engineering output and where direct engineering judgment is required.

• Have improved front-end performance through decisions around bundle size, hydration, rendering, data fetching, and runtime behavior.

• Are comfortable managing server state with TanStack Query and can make deliberate decisions about colocated state and client state libraries.

• Have built or extended component systems using tools such as Radix, shadcn/ui, or custom design systems.

• Understand usability, accessibility, and interaction design well enough to make sound UX decisions without treating design as somebody else's problem.

• Have shipped tested production software using tools such as Vitest or Jest, Testing Library, Playwright, and automated CI/CD pipelines.

**Preferred Experience ➕

**

• Have worked on trading, investment management, portfolio analytics, or other data-intensive financial applications.

• Have worked with AG Grid or comparable data-grid infrastructure for complex datasets and interactions.

• Have worked in a pnpm and Turborepo monorepo with generated API types from OpenAPI specifications.

• Have designed front-end systems supporting multiple tenants, brands, or configurable themes.

• Have mentored engineers or raised engineering standards without moving away from hands-on development.

What we can offer you 🌱

• Work that reaches production fast. We ship weekly. Your work will be used by advisors and financial institutions within days, not quarters.

• Colleagues who set a high bar. Our team comes from Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, and Amazon. Standards are high. Politics are absent.

• Career compression. People here take on scope in twelve months that takes five years elsewhere. If you can carry it, we will give it to you.

• Direct access to founders, customers, and the market. You will sit in the rooms where decisions get made.

• Backing from leading venture funds, and a mandate to become the European standard rather than a regional alternative.

**About Performativ 🚀

**Wealth management runs on software built for a different era. Batch files. Overnight reconciliation. Client reports assembled by hand. Advisors spend more time fighting their systems than advising clients. The industry has accepted this for thirty years.

We are replacing that layer. Performativ is one platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, and client engagement, built from the ground up for how wealth is actually managed today. Banks, family offices, and independent advisors across Europe run on it.

We are a scaleup, not a startup. The product is live, the customers are real, and the growth is ahead of plan. We intend to be the system European wealth management runs on. That is not positioning. It is the plan we are executing against.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com

The bar 🔥

We are builders. We move fast, we say what we think, and we do not manage each other. Autonomy is the default, which only works if you are the kind of person who does not need to be told twice.

This is not a role for someone looking to coast inside a growing company. It is a role for someone who wants scope, wants pressure, and wants to point at something in two years and say they built it. If that is you, apply. If it is not, this will be uncomfortable, and we would rather say so now.

**Strengthen cybersecurity across our medical devices, cloud platforms and digital solutions

**_At UNEEG Medical, we are on a clear mission: improve epilepsy care and enhance patients' quality of life through objective, real-world EEG data. UNEEG EpiSight Solution, our sub-cutaneous EEG monitoring solution enables remote monitoring of brain activity in people with uncontrolled epilepsy and is already making an impact across Europe and the US. We combine the agility of a small company with the high standards of the medical device industry.

_**Your role and team:

**We are looking for a Cyber Security Engineer who will strengthen cybersecurity and information security across UNEEG Medical's products, cloud platforms and supporting infrastructure. You will help ensure that our solutions are developed, deployed and operated securely as we grow in the US healthcare market and continue to support customers across Europe.

You will be part of Technology (R&D) and act as UNEEG Medical's cybersecurity subject-matter expert. Working closely with Product Management, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Operations, Clinical Operations and Commercial, you will embed security throughout the product lifecycle, manage cyber risks and support customer and regulatory security requirements.

**Your main responsibilities will be:

**

• Identify, assess and manage cybersecurity risks across products, cloud platforms and corporate systems

• Define and maintain cybersecurity controls, policies, standards and procedures

• Support secure-by-design practices, security reviews and threat modelling throughout product development

• Assist the software team in vulnerability management, security monitoring and incident response, including root-cause investigations and remediations.

• Translate standards as ISO 27001, NIS2, IEC 81001-5-1, HIPAA, GDPR into a set of pragmatic standard operating procedures for UNEEG Medical to follow in order to be cyber security compliant.

• Maintain security documentation, risk assessments and evidence for audits and regulatory submissions

• Support cybersecurity requirements for medical devices and US healthcare market access

• Advise internal teams and support customer security questionnaires, risk assessments and cybersecurity discussions

• Promote cybersecurity awareness and collaborate with external security partners and auditors

**You will thrive in this role if you:

**

• Combine solid technical expertise with a practical, hands-on and collaborative mindset

• See security as an enabler and help teams create secure solutions rather than acting as a gatekeeper

• Take ownership of risks and remediation activities and follow issues through to completion

• Are structured and document decisions, actions and evidence systematically

• Can communicate complex security topics clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Enjoy working across disciplines and continuously improving security practices

**Your background:

**

• A bachelor's or master's degree in cybersecurity, computer science, software engineering, IT infrastructure or a related field; equivalent practical experience may substitute formal education

• At least 3-5 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, information security, infrastructure security or cloud security

• Experience with FDA cybersecurity requirements for medical devices

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure security services and cloud security architecture

• Experience with vulnerability management, security monitoring and incident response

• Knowledge of identity and access management, network security, endpoint security and secure system architecture

• Familiarity with cybersecurity risk management frameworks and standards

• Fluent professional English, both written and spoken

**It will be an advantage if you have experience with:

**

• MedTech, healthcare IT, SaaS or other regulated environments

• ISO 27001, NIS2, IEC 81001-5-1, HIPAA, GDPR or similar frameworks

• DevSecOps and secure software development lifecycle practices

• Penetration testing management and security assessments

• Kubernetes, container security or cloud-native architecture

• Relevant certifications, such as CISSP, CISM, AZ-500, Security+, SC-100 or equivalent

Applicants must be eligible to work in Denmark and possess a valid work and residence permit if applicable. At this time, we are unable to support work permit applications or sponsorships.

**What we offer:

**

• A key role in supporting secure and scalable customer solutions in a growing medical device company

• Close collaboration with skilled colleagues and international hospital stakeholders

• A workplace with great energy, social activities and a culture of togetherness

• A role based at our modern HQ in Allerød with good facilities and easy access

At UNEEG Medical, your ideas matter, your work makes a difference, and your colleagues have your back.

**Who to contact:

**For more details about the job, please contact Senior Director, Technology, Kim Heegaard Hansen at +45 25 65 75 01.

**How to apply:

**Apply through our Careers site.

All applications must be in English and are treated confidentially. We screen applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

**About UNEEG Medical

**UNEEG Medical pioneers ultra long-term subcutaneous EEG monitoring to help physicians optimize treatment for epilepsy patients. Our UNEEG EpiSight solution provides objective insights into seizure burden, enabling more personalized care. We collaborate with leading institutions across Europe and the US to help patients regain control of their life. At UNEEG Medical, we are currently 40 dedicated people with diverse backgrounds. Our HQ is in Allerød with subsidiaries in the UK, Germany, Austria and the US. Our core values Togetherness, Integrity, and Dedication guide our work as we catalyze brain health therapy with real-world data.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are curious, collaborative, customer-minded, and motivated by solving real problems for financial professionals, say hello to SimCorp.

At SimCorp, we are guided by our values: caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. We are a people-centered organization that invests in skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in creating an environment where people can grow, feel heard, and be empowered to make an impact.

If this sounds like you, keep reading.

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**You will join SimCorp’s Product Division and work on one of our most critical front-office capabilities: Portfolio Management.

Portfolio managers at asset management firms operate under increasing pressure: volatile markets, complex portfolios, tighter risk constraints, and the need to make better investment decisions faster. Static reports and disconnected tools are no longer enough. Portfolio managers need software that helps them understand portfolio positioning, risk usage, exposures, scenarios, and investment intent — and then translate that insight into action.

That is what we are building.

Built on the SimCorp One platform, our modern Portfolio Management solution helps portfolio managers monitor portfolios, analyze exposures and risk, evaluate alternatives, rebalance, and act within coherent, workflow-driven software designed for true front-office use.

This role exists because Portfolio Management is a strategic growth area for SimCorp and our clients. As Product Manager / Product Owner, you will help turn real portfolio manager workflows into intuitive, scalable software. You do not need to come from a traditional product-management background to succeed. You may have gained relevant experience through value advisory, pre-sales, consulting, implementation, client advisory, or another role where you worked closely with investment-management clients and translated their needs into practical solutions.

The common thread is this: you understand client problems, can structure them clearly, and are motivated to shape software that helps portfolio managers work better every day.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**As Product Manager, you will be accountable for execution, learning, and impact — not just producing backlog items.

You will:

• 
Own the product direction and backlog for one or more Portfolio Management capabilities.

• 
Translate portfolio manager needs, client feedback, and market insight into clear, actionable product increments.

• 
Lead and continuously prioritize the backlog for one or more full-stack scrum teams, balancing client value, product quality, platform direction, and technical health.

• 
Work closely with engineers, designers, architects, product peers, and client-facing colleagues to shape workflows, interactions, and data models that make sense in real front-office contexts.

• 
Build a strong understanding of portfolio manager workflows, including:

• 
Portfolio monitoring and decision preparation

• 
Exposure and risk analysis

• 
Scenario evaluation and rebalancing

• 
Order generation and execution workflows

• 
Write clear product briefs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and decision material focused on user intent and business outcomes.

• 
Use client feedback, internal expertise, usage insight, and delivery learning to validate priorities and iterate quickly.

• 
Collaborate with other Product Owners and Product Managers to ensure coherent front-office workflows across Portfolio Management and adjacent product areas.

• 
Support demos, discovery conversations, and client discussions by grounding the conversation in real portfolio manager use cases.

• 
Act as a consistent voice of the portfolio manager in product, design, and delivery decisions.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with strong ownership, visibility, and direct impact.

**What We Value

**Most importantly, you can see yourself thriving in the role described above. How you acquired the skills matters less than how you apply them.

You may be a strong fit if you have several of the following:

• Experience working with asset managers, investment teams, front-office users, or investment-management technology.

• A background in one or more of the following areas:

• Product management or product ownership

• Value advisory or solution advisory

• Pre-sales or solution consulting

• Business consulting or implementation consulting

• Client advisory, customer success, or professional services in financial technology

• Ability to understand complex client workflows and translate them into clear product needs, priorities, and delivery outcomes.

• Familiarity with portfolio management, portfolio construction, rebalancing, exposure/risk analysis, or order-generation workflows.

• Comfort working with analytics, data, and financial concepts.

• Some knowledge of SimCorp Dimension is clearly a plus, especially if you have worked with front-office, portfolio management, or investment workflows.

Ways of working

• Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

• Ability to structure ambiguous problems and turn them into practical next steps.

• Curiosity about users, workflows, and the “why” behind product decisions.

• Pragmatic, outcome-oriented mindset.

• Ability to zoom out to understand portfolio manager goals — and zoom in to refine workflows, interactions, and details.

• Confidence working with engineers, designers, product peers, and client-facing colleagues.

• Willingness to learn product-management practices if your background is advisory, consulting, or pre-sales.

As a person, you:

• Collaborate naturally with colleagues across disciplines.

• Are comfortable questioning assumptions and navigating complexity.

• Communicate clearly and speak up when needed.

• Balance structure with creativity.

• Care deeply about usability — not just functional completeness.

• Are motivated by creating software that solves real client problems.

**Benefits

**Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. At SimCorp, we believe we can offer more.

In addition to traditional benefits, we provide excellent work-life balance, flexible working hours, and a hybrid workplace model. We also have innovation and personal-development sprints, giving you dedicated time each quarter to master your skills and contribute to company development. There is never only one route — we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible. We process incoming applications continuously. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.

At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in recruitment. To support fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or other non-professional information from your application. Thank you for helping us mitigate bias in the recruitment process.

If you are interested in being part of SimCorp but are not sure whether this role is suitable, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may bring relevant skills from product, advisory, pre-sales, consulting, implementation, or client-facing financial-technology roles. Our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help assess whether this is the right opportunity for you.

We are continually improving our talent-acq

uisition process and aim to make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. During the process, we may ask you to provide feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become a leading provider of integrated investment-management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of Deutsche Börse Group. Following the merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law.

We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**We are looking for a Production Test Development Engineer

****The role

**We are looking for a curious engineer to join the Production Test Development team.

We work in an industry on the path to industrialization. We have a high mix and low volume, deep tech portfolio therefore we are innovative in our approach to implement testing schemes meeting both product requirements and available hardware – but always aiming to create robust test schemes for our on-site production.

You will work on new development projects, ensuring consistency with current test portfolio, and together with the test designer and product technical lead, design and code new test programs.

You will support our production environment by securing minimum downtime and optimizing test routines to ensure products of high quality and reproducibility.

Together with the rest of the team, you will continuously support our test framework and drive continuous improvement across our test programs.

**What do we expect of you?

**You have production test development experience, preferably in an industrial setting.

You have strong competencies in TestStand, LabVIEW, general instrumentation, and signal analysis.

Experience in MS-SQL database integration is considered a plus.

We prefer that you hold a degree in engineering.

Fluency in English (written and spoken) is a must.

**Keep your personal data safe

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

**About OrderYOYO

**We help takeaways and restaurants succeed online by providing them with personalised branded mobile apps, websites and personalised marketing. We are here to ensure that small to medium-sized restaurants and small chains are not subjected to high commissions, and giving the restaurant the ownership of their success!

We serve restaurants across multiple markets, including the UK, Ireland, DACH, the Netherlands and the Nordics, and acquisitions are one part of how we grow. Each business we acquire brings its own platform, data and restaurant partners, and bringing them onto OrderYOYO safely is how we protect and build on that value.

**Purpose of the role

**You will lead the technology integration and migration of businesses that join OrderYOYO, from technical due diligence and integration planning through migration, stabilisation and the retirement of legacy platforms.

You will own the integrated programme plan across engineering, product, data and customer-facing teams, protecting restaurant continuity and tracking delivery costs and agreed benefits.

You will coordinate dependencies with Finance, People, Commercial and other functional owners, rather than owning every aspect of corporate integration.

**Key Responsibilities

****Programme leadership

**

• Own end-to-end programme plans and a consolidated view of scope, timelines, dependencies, budget forecasts and risks.

• Lead workstream owners, agree priorities and capacity with functional leads, and run governance, escalating unresolved trade-offs to the CTPO.

• Embed lessons learned into a repeatable migration and integration approach.

**Pre-completion and Day 1

**

• Inform due diligence with assessments of migration complexity, product gaps, dependencies, effort, costs and delivery risks.

• Prepare integration plans before completion and coordinate Day 1 access, environments, tooling and working practices with incoming teams, engineering, IT and security.

• Coordinate early technical and compliance assessments with specialists and track follow-up actions.

****Data and systems

• Coordinate data migration and integration into our data platform and business systems with data and engineering teams, agreeing mappings, quality checks and reporting requirements.

**Customer migration

**

• Segment customers by size, value, product usage and complexity; lead platform gap analysis and scope decisions.

• Recommend migration waves and sequencing based on customer impact, technical readiness and capacity, adapting plans as capabilities mature and lessons emerge.

• Agree product, data, operational and customer-readiness criteria; coordinate testing and reconciliation of order flows, payments and key integrations, securing accountable-owner sign-off.

• Coordinate wave runbooks covering preparation, cutover, validation, rollback and support; lead go/no-go recommendations for approval by accountable business and technical owners.

• Own operational handover, including named support owners, stabilisation exit criteria and business acceptance; plan controlled legacy retirement after migration.

****Stakeholders

• Align engineering, product, customer-facing and finance teams around one plan and timeline, working with customer-facing teams to keep restaurant partners informed and supported.

**Commercial outcomes and reporting

**

• Partner with Finance to establish and track business cases, covering migration and parallel-running costs, revenue at risk, legacy-retirement savings and forecast cost to complete.

• Verify realised benefits with business owners and report progress, customer experience and value delivered to the CTPO and leadership team.

**Skills And Experience Required

**

• 5+ years of programme management experience in a technology organisation, including at least 3 years leading platform migrations, customer migrations or post-acquisition integrations.

• Demonstrated ownership of complex, customer-facing platform migrations, including readiness assessment, cutover, post-migration stabilisation and transition into normal operations.

• Strong technical literacy: comfortable discussing APIs, data pipelines, CRM migrations, cutover plans and infrastructure decommissioning with engineers.

• Experience segmenting large customer bases into migration waves, with detailed run books, rollback, hypercare and clear go or no-go criteria.

• Commercial judgement: you can weigh the cost of a feature gap against the revenue at risk and drive a decision.

• Excellent stakeholder management across engineering, product, commercial and executive audiences, with a proven ability to secure commitments, resolve competing priorities and lead delivery without relying on direct line-management authority.

• Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including executive-level reporting.

• Comfortable working across countries, cultures and time zones.

**Nice to have

**

• Experience in SaaS, restaurant technology, food ordering, payments or marketplaces.

• Experience with data platform and CRM migrations.

• Direct post-acquisition integration experience, and running a repeatable migration approach across multiple programmes.

• A recognised programme management qualification such as MSP, PRINCE2 or PgMP.

**What We Offer

**

• A senior role with direct visibility to the executive team and real influence on how OrderYOYO grows.

• Ownership of our migration and integration capability from day one, with the autonomy to shape how it works.

• Room to grow: as the portfolio expands, the opportunity to build this capability into a dedicated function and lead it.

• Work across nine European markets alongside engineering, product, data and commercial teams.

**Overview

**Corti is the frontier lab for clinical-grade AI, building world-leading models and infrastructure for the realities of healthcare.

Our technology powers healthcare’s most ambitious software, from EHR vendors and virtual care platforms to the health systems that care depends on. We work with builders ranging from fast-moving startups to global healthcare enterprises, helping them bring clinical AI into real-world care.

Healthcare is full of problems where AI has to do more than simply work. Clinicians are overwhelmed by documentation. Coding errors, backlogs and denials cost health systems billions. And the specialist expertise patients need is not always available when they need it.

We build AI specifically for these environments, trained on real patient interactions, validated against real outcomes, and designed to perform where accuracy, trust and reliability matter. If you want to help define how AI is built for healthcare, you belong at Corti.

**The Role

**We’re looking for a GTM Engineer to help build the systems behind a smarter, more scalable go-to-market engine at Corti. You’ll connect the tools and data that power our commercial teams, turning fragmented systems into a reliable foundation for automation, insight, and action.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of software, data, and business impact. You’ll partner closely with Growth, Sales, DevEx Growth, and Platform to design workflows, improve data quality, and build the internal products and automations that help us move faster as we scale.

**What you'll be doing includes, but is not limited to:

****Data foundation

**

• Build and maintain the integrated data layer across Corti’s commercial data systems, bringing together data from tools such as Stripe, Attio, Supabase, Calendly, and Leexi.

• Own the event tracking layer, instrumenting key product and commercial touchpoints so analytics tools (PostHog, Mixpanel, etc.) reflect what's actually happening.

• Build enrichment pipelines that pull from third-party data providers and internal signals to keep ICP records current and scored.

**Systems and automation

**

• Design and implement workflows, automations, and backend services that improve how commercial teams operate, from pipeline management and deal acceleration to post-sale handoffs.

• Identify repetitive GTM processes and systematically eliminate them through automation, freeing commercial teams to focus on higher-judgment work.

**Activation and tooling

**

• Build systems that surface timely signals and enable proactive, data-driven GTM execution, including AI-powered internal tools and agentic workflows where appropriate.

• Build internal tools that reduce manual work for sales, CS, and growth, such as automated account research, meeting prep summaries, or usage-based alert systems.

• Partner with Growth and RevOps to define the data models and pipeline logic that underpin campaign targeting, segmentation, and attribution.

**Cross-functional impact

**

• Collaborate as the primary technical builder for GTM teams across Growth, Enterprise Sales, Developer Experience, and Scaled Customer Experience, translating process needs into robust, scalable solutions.

• Document all built components so systems remain understandable and extensible as the team scales.

• Contribute to engineering quality through clean implementation, thoughtful code review, and cross-functional collaboration.

**What You Bring

**

• Experience as a software engineer, ideally at mid-level, with exposure to growth, sales, or other go-to-market teams.

• Strong proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript, with a backend or server-side engineering focus.

• Experience integrating business-critical tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, or similar systems.

• Familiarity with analytics and data tooling such as PostHog, Mixpanel, Segment, Google Analytics, Amplitude, or Google Tag Manager.

• Experience working with ETL processes, data synchronization, or workflow automation is a plus, but not required.

• Excellent English verbal and written communication skills, including all-remote communication.

**Life at Corti

**

• You will be reporting to VP of Growth

• The position is full-time and starts as soon as possible.

Stay close to the code. Lead a development team. Help shape how we build software at Dalux.

**Dalux is growing, and we are looking for experienced software developers who want to combine hands-on engineering with technical leadership.

As a Team Lead, you lead from within the development team. Around half of your time is spent developing software, while the rest is focused on technical direction, product collaboration, planning, mentoring, and helping your team perform at its best.

You will have significant influence on both the products we build and how we build them – including how we use agentic AI across software development.

**Your role

**Each Dalux development team owns one or more areas of our product portfolio, including its functionality, architecture, quality, performance, reliability, and long-term technical health.

As Team Lead, you are the technical anchor of the team. You work closely with developers, a Product Manager, and a Product Designer to understand problems, set technical direction, and turn product priorities into high-quality software.

This is primarily a technical leadership role rather than a traditional people-management position, and you will spend approximately 50% of your time developing software hands-on.

The rest of your role typically includes:

• Setting technical direction and defining architectural solutions with the team

• Working with the Product Manager to understand requirements, challenge scope, and translate priorities into development work

• Planning and prioritizing work while maintaining a healthy and sustainable flow

• Helping the team break down complex technical and product problems

• Mentoring developers through technical sparring, reviews, and day-to-day collaboration

• Taking responsibility for the quality and long-term health of your team's software

• Identifying opportunities to improve architecture, tools, development practices, and ways of working

• Driving improvements beyond your own team when they can make Dalux Development better

We expect Team Leads to have opinions, challenge existing approaches, and create clarity when there is no obvious answer.

**Leading development with agentic AI

**We are significantly increasing our use of agentic AI in software development.

We use and explore AI across the development lifecycle – from understanding problems and navigating codebases to implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, and review.

As a Team Lead, you are expected to have hands-on experience using agentic AI in your own development workflow. The specific tools matter less than how you use them: providing the right context and direction, critically evaluating the output, and knowing when to intervene or take a different approach.

Your role goes beyond your own workflow. You will help your team experiment with agentic development, identify where it genuinely improves engineering effectiveness, share useful practices, and maintain the engineering judgment and quality standards required for production software.

AI can increase what capable developers can achieve, but responsibility for architecture, correctness, maintainability, and quality remains with the team.

**Technologies we work with

**Our platform is built on a distributed cloud architecture using AWS.

Depending on the team, you may work with technologies such as:

• Full-stack: C# / .NET, Angular / TypeScript, GitHub Copilot, MSSQL, Elasticsearch, WebGL, DirectX

• Mobile: .NET MAUI, Vulkan

• AI and Computer Vision: C++, Python, computer vision and machine learning technologies

Which team you lead depends on your technical background, interests, leadership experience, and where we see the strongest match.

**Product development at Dalux

**Our developers do more than implement specifications.

Developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers work together to understand problems and find solutions that balance user value, usability, technical feasibility, business viability, and long-term technical health.

As Team Lead, you bring the technical perspective into those discussions. You help the team understand why we are building something, challenge proposed solutions when necessary, and ensure technical considerations are part of product decisions from the beginning.

**Your background

**You are an experienced software developer who enjoys taking responsibility beyond your own code.

You may already be a Team Lead or Lead Developer. Or you may be the developer others turn to when a difficult technical decision needs to be made, a problem needs structure, or another developer needs help moving forward.

We expect that you:

• Have solid professional software development experience

• Have at least six months of practical experience using agentic AI as part of your software development workflow

• Have an educational background in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a closely related technical field

• Have experience taking a key technical role within a development team

• Are comfortable making and facilitating technical decisions

• Enjoy mentoring and helping other developers improve

• Can create structure and direction without controlling every detail

• Have strong communication, facilitation, and planning skills

• Care about maintainability, reliability, performance, and engineering quality

• Understand how to balance short-term delivery with long-term technical health

• Can identify opportunities to improve development practices and ways of working

Experience with our exact technology stack is useful, but technical judgment, leadership ability, and strong software engineering fundamentals matter more.

**What You Can Expect From Dalux

**Dalux is a software company at heart, and software development is central to how we create value.

As a Team Lead, you can expect:

• Hands-on engineering – leadership does not mean leaving software development behind

• Real technical influence – short paths between ideas, discussions, and decisions

• Meaningful team ownership – teams own both product functionality and the technology behind it

• Strong technical colleagues – daily sparring with developers who care about what they build

• Close product collaboration – developers work directly with Product Managers and Product Designers

• Room to improve how we work – Team Leads are expected to challenge and evolve our development practices

• An environment actively investing in agentic AI – with the opportunity to shape how your team works with it

• High levels of trust and freedom in how you and your team solve problems

All Dalux software development takes place in-house at our headquarters in Vibenshuset, Copenhagen.

We believe working together in person makes technical collaboration, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and fast decision-making significantly easier.

**About Dalux

**Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard.

We build digital tools that make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. Using our own 3D BIM technology, we develop software used in more than 140 countries worldwide.

Our core technology is developed entirely in-house, giving our developers and technical leaders the opportunity to influence both the products and the technology behind them.

**Ready to lead from within the team?

**If you want greater technical responsibility and influence while continuing to build software hands-on, we would like to hear from you.

**If agentic AI is already part of how you develop software, tell us how you use it – and how you think a development team can use it effectively without compromising engineering quality.

**We recruit continuously and hire multiple Team Leads as Dalux continues to grow.

If you have questions about the position, contact IT Talent Acquisition Specialist Line Hassenkam Klinge on LHP@dalux.com

We’re looking for an experienced red teamer with proven credentials in agentic red teaming to join our advanced product and research team.

**What You’ll Do

**You’ll join the team dedicated to building and developing a tool that dynamically tests and evaluates large language models (LLMs) and their native application context for vulnerabilities.

You’ll be working with seasoned reverse engineers, application pentesters, red teamers, and data scientists, bridging multiple digital disciplines by creating a unique suite that gives our clients the capability to test, remediate, and harden their agentic workloads.

**What You’ll Bring

**Most of all, we value ingenuity, curiosity, and drive. You may be a great fit for this role if you have experience with:

• Building or contributing to tools used for dynamic application testing

• Working extensively with open source or proprietary tools used for web and application pentesting

• Actively adopting LLMs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) in automating and enhancing your penetration tests

• Spending time researching agentic vulnerabilities and attending relevant trainings or conferences

**To Fit Right In Here At The Tech Collective

**

• You should be genuinely curious about new developments within the red teaming domain

• You possess the willingness to tackle new and technical challenges as they arise

• You know how to break down and structure complex assignments and enjoy sharing your knowledge and insights with your team members

• You possess a startup mentality to help drive the innovation and ingenuity of our red team products

• You can cooperate seamlessly with different profiles in a highly diverse team of researchers, developers, consultants, and red teamers

We don’t expect you to know everything – after all, agentic security is a rapidly evolving field! In this role, we’re looking for someone who wants to own, develop, and innovate the product modules related to testing the application context (e.g., API security, cryptographic implementation, broken authentication, RBAC) and supporting infrastructure (e.g., misconfigurations, server-side vulnerabilities) for the agents that we test.

To succeed in this role, your experience and competencies should include:

Professional experience

• A minimum of five years’ progressive experience in enterprise red teaming or offensive research

• A proven track record of web application pentesting with an emphasis on remediation and hardening

• Experience defining and driving product roadmaps for red team tools (not required, but highly valued)

• Demonstrated ability to evaluate complex technology stacks, including common cloud platforms (M365/Azure, Google, or AWS), CI/CD pipelines, and AI-powered platforms and systems

• Experience communicating technical findings to non-technical stakeholders and the ability to bring technical assessments to life

Technical competencies

• Familiarity with both Mitre and OWASP frameworks, and experience applying them in client reporting

• Relevant security certifications (e.g., OSCP, OSCE, OSEP, GIAC GPEN/GXPN, etc.) are a plus, indicating solid foundational knowledge and commitment to the offensive security field.

• Prior experience developing agent-specific attack types such as prompt injection, memory & context poisoning, or jailbreaking

• A working understanding of MCP, LLM pipelines, the functional aspects of LLMs, and how modern agent solutions are integrated with widely used cloud suites such as M365 or AWS

Finally, experience in intermediate to advanced vulnerability research related to applications or operating systems will be considered a strong plus, but is not a requirement for this role.

What we offer

On top of a competitive salary and bonus package, we offer you the opportunity to join a unique team of experts and enthusiasts in your field. Our expectations are matched by our willingness to invest in your development – whether through training, conferences, or the opportunity to pursue research in areas you’re passionate about.

We combine remote work with meaningful co-working at our offices in Copenhagen and will provide you with the tooling and hardware required to reach our goal of building a unique red team platform.

For questions or enquiries, feel free to contact Anders Rømer Skøtt at anrs@thetechcollective.eu // +45 31717487.

Do you want to help shape global ethics and compliance in one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies? Would you like to use your legal and/or compliance expertise and pharmaceutical industry experience to help our organisation make the right decisions? Join Novo as a Senior Compliance Counsel in the Ethics & Compliance (E&C) Strategic Operations and Advice team.

Anchored within the Business Ethics Compliance Office (BECO), this role offers the opportunity to provide practical advice, strengthen global compliance processes and help turn our ethics and compliance strategy into action

**What You’ll Bring

**You bring strong ethics and compliance, legal or adjacent experience from a complex multinational environment, combined with the judgement to turn regulatory requirements into practical advice. You are comfortable building relationships across functions and communicating complex topics clearly.

• A degree in Law, Business or similar

• A strong professional track record from an Ethics & Compliance or Legal function

• Experience identifying, assessing and mitigating ethics and compliance risks

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to provide clear and practical guidance

• Fluency in written and spoken English

• Experience working in the pharmaceutical, healthcare, biotechnology sectors or FMCG, either directly or through a relevant consultancy or law firm

**As a Senior Compliance Counsel, you will act as an expert and trusted adviser on global Ethics & Compliance (E&C) matters. Reporting to the Director of Strategic Operations and Advice, you will work with colleagues across our global Legal, Ethics & Compliance organisation and the business to identify risks and develop practical, compliant solutions. Your responsibilities will include:

• Provide day-to-day guidance and training on ethics and compliance matters, including anti-bribery and anti-corruption policies and procedures, helping colleagues translate requirements into practical decisions.

• Identify and assess compliance risks and develop proportionate mitigation approaches that support effective implementation globally and at headquarters.

**The Business Ethics Compliance Office (BECO) develops and leads the implementation of Novo’s global ethics & compliance strategy and programme, which focuses on the prevention of fraud, bribery, and off-label promotion. BECO is also responsible for Novo’s global systems and processes related to tracking payments to healthcare professionals, as well as compliance with data protection and AI regulations and respect for human rights.

**You will have the opportunity to apply your expertise to compliance questions with global reach while working closely with colleagues across functions and geographies.
